role_voices.text_zh: 不受女性歡迎？#無所謂，如此美貌招人妒忌是很正常的。
role_voices.text_en: Not a hit with the ladies? #No matter, beauty like this often draws the ire of others.

role_voices.text_zh: 擁有絕世美貌也挺讓人困擾，煩人的蒼蠅總是特別多。
role_voices.text_en: Being a peerless beauty is quite troublesome. Annoying pests always wish to come close.

role_voices.text_zh: 收集寶石是我的興趣。#看，這顆蛋白石是不是很美？
role_voices.text_en: I love collecting precious gems. #Look, isn't this opal super pretty?

role_voices.text_zh: 我喜愛世上所有美麗的事物；當然，也包括你。
role_voices.text_en: I love all the beautiful things in this world. That includes you, of course.

role_voices.text_zh: 只要感覺對了，有多少性伴侶當然都沒有問題。
role_voices.text_en: I can attract as many sexual partners as I want.

role_voices.text_zh: 我的美貌自不必多說，就連身材都是完美無瑕。
role_voices.text_en: My beauty is undeniable, and my body is flawless.

role_voices.text_zh: 掌管愛情的我……第一次有了對人心動的感覺……
role_voices.text_en: As the goddess of love... I've never felt a longing in my heart this strong before...

role_voices.text_zh: 遇見你以前，我以為已經了解了一切美的事物……
role_voices.text_en: I thought I knew all there was to know about beauty before I met you...

role_voices.text_zh: 哈啊……有了你，即使沒有其他男人也……
role_voices.text_en: Hah... If I have you... even if there are no other men...
